query: What remote sensing and modeled flood data products could serve as alternatives or complements to NFIP claims for measuring flood damage/extent at the ZCTA level in the United States?
sub_questions: Sentinel-1 SAR flood mapping (RAPID, Copernicus EMS) - resolution, temporal coverage, latency, access
NOAA/NWS National Water Model (NWM) Retrospective - resolution, temporal span, outputs, access
First Street Foundation flood model - coverage, resolution, access restrictions, cost
MODIS/VIIRS Near Real-Time flood products - resolution, coverage, limitations
Landsat/Sentinel-2 optical flood mapping - cloud limitations, temporal gaps
FEMA Hazus model outputs - publicly available vs local runs
Emerging products (Planet, commercial SAR, AI-based flood mapping)
